projects.title: Learning to Rank Algorithm
projects.description: Design and implemented a learning to rank algorithm using clustering.  This algorithm uses clustering to group document to enhance local features which might otherwise be ignored by machine learning algorithms.  We construct models for each cluster and pair-wise clusters to generate ranking between two documents.  These rankings between documents are used to construct a graph which we use to rank documents based on a heuristic.
